build_id.description: Build-time git short-SHA of the binary that produced this report; "unknown" when built without a .git directory.

collection_errors.description: Errors raised while serializing the report. Audit and measurement failures are represented separately in module_runs, rule_outcomes, and audit_quality.

requested_rules.description: Rules the run must account for with exactly one outcome per listed viewport, ran or not run with a reason; derived from the shared, tree and page rule registrations and the inline rules (#778).

wcag_level.description: WCAG level the run was configured for; a rule above it must not have run (#778).

measurement_profile.description: How the pages were measured: session policy and state-changing journeys (#787).

state_id.description: Name of the declared state the run started from (--state-id).

storage_state.description: Identity of the declared browser state: digest and counts, never values.

display_mode.description: Display mode the scores belong to (#653): site_default without --display.

accessibility_score.description: null for a batch in which no URL produced a report: nothing was measured.

overall_score.description: null for a batch in which no URL produced a report: nothing was measured.

attempted_url_count.description: Batch only: URLs an audit was started for (coverage.attempted).

coverage.description: Batch only: URL lifecycle counters. The averages are over `succeeded` only.

wcag_version.description: WCAG version the coverage ratio is scoped to. Absent in reports produced before the switch to WCAG 2.2, which were scoped to WCAG 2.1.

url_count.description: Number of pages the rule occurs on; 1 in a single report.

rule_id.description: Taxonomy rule id of the finding behind this action; the same id as in pages[].findings[].rule_id.

finding_id.description: Id of the finding behind this action; the same id as in pages[].findings[].id.

root_cause_id.description: Most widespread root cause of this rule (batch only); the same id as in summary.root_causes[].id and pages[].findings[].patterns[].id.

accessibility_subcategory_scores.description: Accessibility score per subcategory (0-100, higher is better). Single reports only.

security_category_scores.description: Security score per category (0-100, higher is better); omitted when the Security module did not run. Single reports only.

module_detail.description: What detail.modules holds: full (collected data), omitted (compact batch projection) or not_restored (cache replay without raw module data). Empty modules mean 'nothing found' only when this is full.

collection_errors.description: Errors raised while serializing this page detail; not audit execution failures.

source_quality.description: Shown as 'Technical preparation for machine processing'. `score` combines `consistency` and `authority`; `substance` holds structural indicators and its `score` is deprecated (not part of `score`, removed in 2.0).

exploitability.description: unconfirmed: the version is in the advisory range, reachability was not examined. not_applicable: only end-of-maintenance notices matched, no specific vulnerability. There is no confirmed state.

review_status.description: unreviewed: the affected range has not been checked against source_url; the match is a lead, not an established statement.

reviewed.description: ISO date of the last check against source_url; absent when unreviewed.

grade.description: Letter grade. Present only for modules with weight_pct > 0 — a module that feeds nothing carries `band` alone (plan 29, D2).

band.description: Canonical English qualitative band for `score` (registry FIVE_BAND). The only qualitative label a module of weight 0 carries.

derived_from.description: Modules this one re-reads instead of measuring anything new. Absent when the module measures its own subject (plan 29, D3).

source.description: Provenance of this evidence item, e.g. "ax_tree", "dom_attribute", "computed".

evidence.description: Machine-readable provenance for this occurrence (DOM path, computed measurements like contrast ratio). Canonical English (#406). Absent/empty when no evidence was collected.

help_url.description: Official reference URL for the criterion (e.g. WCAG Understanding page). Present only for WCAG findings that carry one.

id.description: F- and eight hex digits from the rule; the same on every page and run.

patterns.description: Element patterns of all occurrences, most occurrences first, at most 20.

pattern_count.description: Number of distinct patterns, also beyond the 20 listed.

assurance.description: Basis of confidence/false_positive_risk/verification (#784): detection method and evidence quality of this finding.

category.description: `wcag` for accessibility rule findings, otherwise the contract domain.

exclusionReport.description: Audit exclusions applied to this page (#645). Findings whose element lies inside a subtree matched by one of `selectors` were dropped before normalization and scoring; the page itself was audited. `[data-audit-exclude]` is always applied (builtin). Counts per rule are the larger of the two viewport passes. `rule_outcomes[].findings` count what remains after exclusion.

excluded_occurrences.description: Excluded WCAG finding occurrences, all outcomes.

excluded_screen_reader_issues.description: Screen-reader issues dropped because every node they name lies in an excluded subtree.

matched_elements.description: Roots of excluded subtrees; 0 means the selector excluded nothing. Larger count of the two viewport passes.

invalid.description: The browser rejected the selector; it excluded nothing.

displayModes.description: Display-mode convention (BarrierLab data-display, #653) detected on the page. Absent when the page neither sets html[data-display] nor contains a figure[data-viz].

offers_display_modes.description: html[data-display] carries visual, calm or text.

active_mode.description: Value of html[data-display] when the page was audited.

set_before_body.description: data-display was already set when <body> was parsed; absent when not observed.

reduced_motion.description: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce matched during the audit.

frameCoverage.description: Iframes on the page (#715). `audited`: rendered in the page's own process and checked with the element-level WCAG rules (page-level rules such as landmarks, h1, title, viewport and skip link run on the top document only). `skipped`: not audited, with the reason. Findings inside a frame carry the selector `"{iframe} [frame] {element}"`.

selector.description: The iframe element; nested frames as "{outer} [frame] {inner}".

url.description: The frame document's URL, or the src attribute.

reason.description: Why the frame was skipped (skipped frames only). cross_origin: rendered out of process (site isolation), see frame-tested; hidden: not perceivable (hidden, aria-hidden, role none/presentation, not rendered, at most 1px, or ignored in the accessibility tree); excluded: inside an audit exclusion.

id.description: RC- and eight hex digits; equals summary.root_causes[].id for a recurring pattern.

subcheckRun.description: One sub-analysis or collector of a module run. Collectors under the collection contract also carry their state, method and version; a scoring collection that lost its measurement makes the module score partial and non-contributing.

subcheck.description: Collector id `<module>.<collector>` (or a legacy sub-analysis name).

decision.description: The decision under the stored profile (decision contract). Every output and the exit code project this value; thresholds compare the accessibility score.

findingContract.description: Finding contract shared by every domain.

cause.description: Canonical cause key; findings of different domains with the same cause describe one defect.

inventoryEntry.description: How a collected non-WCAG problem is represented: a finding id or an explicit exclusion.
